exits.label: Grondar's Barrow
exits.description: A boss lair beyond Varrick. Enter deliberately; return to the road outside.

exits.label: Zaryth's Throne
exits.description: A gated boss lair outside Faloden. Your progress is checked before entry.

exits.label: Draynar Fiend Pit
exits.description: A fiend lair outside Draynar. Enter when you are ready for combat.

exits.label: Dragon Roost
exits.description: A shared dragon lair near Draynar, housing green, red and black dragons.

exits.label: Lumbright Cow Pasture
exits.description: A separate pasture beyond Lumbright. Cows and bulls roam inside.
